debug.label: debug-summary
debug.script: return _G.RBA and _G.RBA.snapshot and _G.RBA.snapshot() or { error = 'RBA debug runtime not installed' }

ui-test.label: gui-summary
ui-test.script: local Players = game:GetService('Players'); local player = Players.LocalPlayer; local gui = player and player:FindFirstChildOfClass('PlayerGui'); local children = {}; if gui then for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do children[#children + 1] = { name = child.Name, className = child.ClassName } end end; return { playerGui = gui, children = children }
